content.short: Satori is a perpetuals trading platform with leveraged crypto markets and support for TON among its networks.
content.description: Satori is a perps trading platform for users who want leveraged exposure to crypto assets. Its site describes trading with up to 25x leverage, point farming, a web app, and network support that includes TON along with Ethereum, BNB, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, ZKsync, and others. The listing is TON-related because Satori explicitly includes TON in its supported trading network set. Satori Perp belongs in TON DeFi because its main workflow gives users a way to trade, earn, borrow, stake, or manage liquidity through an actual product surface.
